tools.description: What the duck is doing right now: label, bring-up state, whether it has fallen, the trunk position and the gravity vector.
tools.name: duck_state

tools.description: Drive the duck. vx is forward (m/s, up to 0.6), vy is sideways, wz is yaw rate (rad/s). The command holds for one second unless repeated, and the safety layer can always preempt it.
tools.name: duck_move

tools.description: Stop driving and stand still.
tools.name: duck_stop

tools.description: Run one of the duck's own one-shot skills: roulade, kick_left, kick_right, or one of the 13 official emotions (curious, excited, sad, laugh, yes, no, ...). Get the full list from GET /skills.
tools.name: duck_skill

tools.description: Stroke the duck: it counts the pet, coos, and stays lively a little longer. The phone's stand-in for pet_detect on the physical robot's shell.
tools.name: duck_pet

tools.description: Drop a treat: the duck does its official ground-pick peck at the floor and a satisfied sound. Digital-only ritual built from official moves; counted in the life record.
tools.name: duck_feed

tools.description: The duck's lifetime record: seconds powered, walking and held; falls, pickups, sit/stand counts; every skill and emotion it has run, by name; metres walked.
tools.name: duck_life

tools.description: The duck's companion state: hunger (0 fed .. 1 starving), mood (-1 sad .. 1 happy), bond (0..1), and whether it has dozed off. Pet or feed it to move these; they age on the duck's own clock.
tools.name: duck_care

tools.description: The duck's joy-ride: hold=true starts the official wheee (start segment + repeating loops), hold=false ends it. This is the held sound the physical duck's trigger makes.
tools.name: duck_wheee

tools.description: Aim the head at a point in the duck's own frame (metres: x forward, y left, z up; the duck's position is /state.pose). Returns the joint angles and whether the aim was clamped by the servos' travel.
tools.name: duck_look

tools.description: Say something to the duck in Chinese or English and it does the matching verb: 坐下/sit, 翻滚/roll, 开心/excited, 摇头/no, 捡起来/pick, ... Returns what it heard and what it did.
tools.name: duck_hear

tools.description: Toggle the duck's virtual face flashlight, or set it to one of robotd's seven colours: white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta.
tools.name: duck_flashlight

tools.description: Sit down, or stand back up if already sitting.
tools.name: duck_sit

tools.description: Run the ground-pick motion: reach down with the beak.
tools.name: duck_ground_pick

tools.description: Aim the head. Angles in radians; the real duck's neck and head axes.
tools.name: duck_head

tools.description: Switch drive bundles: walk (legs) or roller (wheels). The whole policy set changes, exactly as the robot's mode line. The duck must be standing still.
tools.name: duck_mode

tools.description: Power the duck off the way the robot does: sit down, ease into the rest pose, cut torque. The battery EMAs to empty on its own and runs the same sequence.
tools.name: duck_shutdown

tools.description: Power the duck back on after a shutdown.
tools.name: duck_power

tools.description: Make the duck's voice: greet, chirp, coo, peck, inquire or alarm. Rendered by the robot's own synth, so it sounds like the duck and not like a sample.
tools.name: duck_sound

tools.description: Open or close the beak, 0..1. The mouth is not part of any policy; the idle yawn only ever opens it further.
tools.name: duck_mouth

tools.description: The phone's latest camera, microphone, depth and IMU readings, tagged with the mode they were taken in. None of them is part of the duck's own observation.
tools.name: duck_sensors

tools.description: Which scene, meshes and policies this build is running, as one SHA-256 fingerprint.
tools.name: duck_provenance

tools.description: The simulation clock: tick, paused, speed, and the checkpoints available to rewind to.
tools.name: duck_time

tools.description: Freeze the duck, or resume it.
tools.name: duck_pause

tools.description: Copy the duck at this instant into an independent branch.
tools.name: duck_fork
